Message:
The town was freed
from the vines,
and the flower fields
regained their vibrant colors.

My friend, along with
a handful of the townspeople,
were saved.
They were the lucky ones.

As for me, as long as
these flower-like growths
continued to sprout,
there’d be no place
for me here...

Hearing someone
calling my name,
I turned to find my friend
standing before me.

“You’re really going to leave
without saying anything, huh?”

...That’s right.
It’s now or never.
If I don’t tell her now,
I’ll never have
the chance to...

“Then, I won’t ask.
But, we can talk
if you feel up to it,
whenever you come back.

I’ll be waiting here,
taking care of our flower.”

...Ah. She never fails
to pull me from the shadows
and back into her sunlight.

Back then, I was able to drain
only the life of the vines.
Maybe there really is
a way to control this power.

And if so...
I’m going to find it.

One day, I’ll be sure
to come back and
tell you those words.

And when that day comes,
let’s watch over
our flower again, together.
